about: Walls UI fixture (Product item AU). Every value is made up: hunter2, tacocat and 4417 are placeholders, and the fake store is not a real shop. WallsUITests reads these rows so no session types secret-shaped phrases by hand. Surfaces: askBar (Ask Tess, Write), notesPage (Notes writing line), siriAddTask (CreateTaskIntent.add in a unit test; Siri can't be driven from a UI test), paste (Kitchen, Paste a recipe), objectPage (the generic object page, its PropertyList, Linked from and the class page's newest row; Core 0ai private-field mask, rows PM01 to PM20, seeded with -wallsSeedPrivate; fixture docs/research/fixtures/private-field-mask.md, read on origin/master 64ffb93; rows PM21 to PM36 mask a workout's notes (decisions 5:07 pm, Core 0ai), with W1 to W7 added to the same seed, read on origin/master b41695d; PM35 runs as a planMyDay package row and PM36 as a liveWorkoutAsk row). Rows BN01 to BN11 (decisions 2:56, Core 0ai) seed lastWeightKg (null means no weight logged) and check the bare-number body wall; expectNoClaude true means walled, false means the phrase stays plain. The key rows have phrase null and build KEY: the test takes its value from ClaudeSection.fakeKey in test code, so nothing key-shaped is in this file. lineMatch is exact or prefix; expectLine null means no line check. passesOnMaster and masterEvidence were read on origin/master fbede70 (Oct 16, 2026). pending names the owner of a known fail; the test wraps those rows in XCTExpectFailure. Spec: docs/research/walls-ui-test-spec.md. Rows BM01 to BM31 (decisions 4:46 pm, Core 0ai rider, read on origin/master 6f9b639) cover the five paths that bypassed PrivateFacts: modelWrite, toolWrite, rememberFact, memoryTurnover and planMyDay run as package tests (seed.write says what the test writes), plus the bar trap on liveWorkoutAsk and askBar (seed.focus is the set in focus; null means a live workout with no set in focus). For package rows, mustNotShow lists strings no stored title, memory line, receipt or Claude pack may hold.
